_comment: Documentation-only target descriptor. ESP32-S3 is a Xtensa LX7 part and CANNOT be built through fbt/SConstruct, which hardcodes the ARM GCC toolchain and STM32 linker/startup files used by f7/f18. There is no 'inherit' relationship possible at the toolchain level. The actual buildable project for this target lives in /esp32s3_port (a standalone ESP-IDF/CMake project) and vendors furi/core sources directly. This file exists only to document pin mapping / hardware profile in the same place other targets keep it, and as a placeholder for a real fbt cross-target entry if a future contributor teaches site_scons about a second toolchain.

unavailable_on_this_board: CC1101 sub-GHz radio (no equivalent silicon on ESP32-S3; needs external module + full furi_hal_subghz rewrite)
ST25R3916 NFC/RFID front-end (needs external module + full furi_hal_nfc rewrite)
Infrared (needs external IR LED + carrier-PWM driver; ESP32-S3 RMT peripheral is a plausible replacement, not yet implemented)
Flipper's ST-proprietary BLE stack (ESP32-S3 has its own Bluetooth LE controller/stack; profiles must be reimplemented against esp-idf's NimBLE, not ported)
SD card slot wiring (board-dependent; not assumed present)
